title: Enforce run path scope and retry budgets deterministically
description: Implement the approved TASK-277 scope and budget slice after minimal run manifests exist. Add readable, writable, and forbidden path contracts, dispatch preflight, post-run diff verification, and bounded attempt, tool-failure, and runtime envelopes. Claim hard containment only where the harness demonstrably enforces it; otherwise block submission and escalate.
acceptance_criteria: Run manifests declare readable, writable, and forbidden paths plus maximum attempts, tool failures, and runtime.
Dispatch preflight rejects invalid or overlapping scope contracts before model work starts.
Post-run verification detects out-of-scope writes and blocks submission until a recorded scope expansion or rollback occurs.
Retry or runtime exhaustion produces a durable escalation artifact instead of an unbounded loop.
Tests distinguish prompt-level guidance, post-run enforcement, and genuine harness containment so documentation never overclaims the security boundary.
